description: Baseline: replaces every BitPermutationLUT + DominanceCanonicalize + DominanceToVector with a simple BordaFFN (Linear -> x4 FFN -> LN). All arithmetic is float; no dominance, no bit weights, no LUT kernels. Q/K/V/out_proj each become a BordaFFN. Drops bit_lut_* config; standard torch.optim.Adam handles everything.
